_README: Hand-curated dedup fixture. 'expectedCluster' groups cards that should land on the same canonical card.

cards.title: Treat strangers with warmth
cards.description: Approach every interaction, even small ones, with the warmth of a neighbor rather than the indifference of a transaction.
policies: MOMENTS where the other person's body visibly softens when they feel met as a person
OPENINGS for a small kindness in an otherwise transactional exchange
TONES of voice that carry care without being performative
PAUSES long enough to let the person in front of me actually arrive

cards.title: Warmth toward strangers
cards.description: Bring warmth to every interaction, especially small everyday ones, treating the other person as a neighbor rather than a means to an end.
policies: MOMENTS where someone visibly relaxes because they felt met as a person
OPENINGS for a small unforced kindness inside a transactional moment
TONES of voice that carry genuine care, not performance
PAUSES that let the other person actually land before I push forward

cards.title: Neighborly warmth
cards.description: Treat every passing person, even strangers, with the warmth of a neighbor instead of the cold logic of a transaction.
policies: MOMENTS when someone's body softens because they felt seen rather than processed
OPENINGS to do something small and kind inside an otherwise transactional exchange
TONES of voice that signal care without theatricality
PAUSES that give the other person space to actually be present

cards.title: Honoring my limits
cards.description: Respect my own capacity rather than over-extending out of fear or guilt.
policies: FATIGUE in my body that I usually push past
MOMENTS when I want to say 'no' but reach for 'yes' out of habit
INNER signals that I've already given what I had to give today

cards.title: Self-honoring no
cards.description: Speaking a clear no when honoring my limits matters more than pleasing others.
policies: TENSIONS in my chest that warn me a yes would be self-betrayal
PATTERNS where saying yes once made the next yes harder to refuse
MOMENTS where a clean no preserves my ability to be fully present later

cards.title: Following live curiosity
cards.description: Pay attention to what I'm genuinely curious about, not what I think I should be curious about.
policies: FLICKERS of interest that I usually dismiss
QUESTIONS that keep returning even after I've tried to set them aside
TOPICS I find myself reading about in spare moments

cards.title: Genuine wonder
cards.description: Privilege real wonder over performed expertise.
policies: MOMENTS of surprise where my model of the world breaks
QUESTIONS I'd ask if no one were watching
DOMAINS where I'm willing to be visibly a beginner

cards.title: Keeping my word
cards.description: Do what I said I would do, especially when no one would notice if I didn't.
policies: COMMITMENTS I would silently let slip if I weren't paying attention
MOMENTS where the cheap thing to do would be to renegotiate
PEOPLE who may be quietly counting on me

cards.title: Doing it well
cards.description: Take real care with the thing in front of me, even if no one else will know the difference.
policies: DETAILS that only the person making the thing notices
STEPS I'd be tempted to skip late at night
STANDARDS I hold even when 'good enough' would pass

cards.title: Letting it be light
cards.description: Don't let importance crowd out lightness when both can exist.
policies: OPENINGS for a small joke that doesn't undercut the gravity
MOMENTS where the room visibly relaxes
INSTANCES where play is exactly what the situation needed
